mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shelter (shelter_id, shelter_name, address, admin_id, shelter_cap, shelter_cur, money_cur, money_req) VALUES (#{shelterId}, #{shelterName}, #{address}, #{adminId}, #{shelterCap}, #{shelterCur}, #{moneyCur}, #{moneyReq})
mapper.update: UPDATE shelter SET shelter_name = #{shelterName}, address = #{address}, admin_id = #{adminId}, shelter_cap = #{shelterCap}, shelter_cur = #{shelterCur}, money_cur = #{moneyCur}, money_req = #{moneyReq} WHERE shelter_id = #{shelterId}
